biggest_catch: This is not a free $500 — you must park $5,000 in the account for 90+ days AND run either $5,000 of payroll or $2,000 of debit spending through it every 30 days, and the application must use a referral code from an official BlueVine partner page.
catches: Must apply through an official BlueVine partner page (on bluevine.com) using its referral code (e.g., FSM500) — applying from the regular BlueVine homepage without a code does not qualify.
Deposit a total of $5,000 within the first 30 days of opening.

After day 30, maintain a minimum daily balance of $5,000 AND complete at least one of the following every 30 days for 90 days: (a) $5,000+ of outbound payroll payments via eligible payroll providers, or (b) $2,000+ of eligible spend on the Bluevine Business Debit Mastercard and/or Bluevine Business Cashback Mastercard (excluded transactions listed on the page).
Bluevine is a financial technology company, not a bank; deposits are FDIC-insured through Coastal Community Bank, Member FDIC, and program banks.
No monthly or overdraft fees, but the $5,000 parked balance has a real opportunity cost.

steps: Go to an official BlueVine partner offer page on bluevine.com (e.g., the FitSmallBusiness page) and note its referral code (FSM500).
Apply for a Bluevine Business Checking account by January 31, 2027 using that referral code.
Deposit a total of $5,000 into the new account within the first 30 days.
From day 31 onward, keep at least a $5,000 minimum daily balance.

Every 30 days for 90 days, complete one of: $5,000+ in outbound payroll payments through eligible payroll providers, or $2,000+ in eligible Bluevine debit/card spend (check the page's excluded-transactions list).
After the 90-day qualification period, the $500 bonus is paid.
timing: Bonus paid after the 90-day activity qualification window; exact payout date not specified on the page.
